metadata.description: Agent tooling for Vale, the prose linter.

plugins.name: vale
plugins.description: Onboard a repository to Vale in one prompt, tune its style choices, turn a style guide into tested rules, and keep prose linted as you edit.

plugins.name: vale-lsp
plugins.description: Vale's language server for Claude Code: alerts on prose files arrive as diagnostics after each edit. Experimental; needs the vale-ls binary on PATH.

plugins.name: vale-onboard
plugins.description: A pane for setting up Vale: compare style packages against your docs, decide what each noisy rule does, tick the words that are right, and hand the result to Claude to apply. Experimental.

plugins.name: vale-tools
plugins.description: Vale as tools Claude can call: lint a draft or a file against the project's own rules, and run a style's test cases, without a shell command. Experimental.
